objectives.title: Read the flag
objectives.prompt: Force a second OGNL evaluation through the id parameter, run a command and read /ctf/flag.
hints: The page puts the id parameter into a tag attribute with forced evaluation. Read the S2-061 advisory, and S2-059 before it.

steps.title: Identify the framework
steps.prompt: Which Java web framework serves the page? (name only)

steps.title: Name the advisory
steps.prompt: Which Struts security bulletin covers this bug?

steps.title: Find the parameter
steps.prompt: Which request parameter is evaluated twice? (parameter name)
